functions.name: projectile_spawn
functions.note: Recursive Fire Bullets add-on, 64-slot allocator, all return paths.

functions.name: weapon_name_get
functions.note: Native table accessor multiplies the weapon id by 120.

functions.name: weapon_table_init
functions.note: Complete initializer; the heuristic entry-point inventory split its body at an interior address.

functions.name: player_update
functions.note: Native gameplay caller has a 0x354-byte player stride and no dedicated Fire Bullets firing branch.

functions.name: creature_apply_damage
functions.note: Complete damage/perk/impulse and death pipeline; no Living Fortress modifier in 1.9.8.

functions.name: perks_update_effects
functions.note: Complete timed bonus and perk-effect update; older Jinxed comparison and no freeze gate.

functions.name: bonus_apply
functions.note: Complete bonus application, including Fire Bullets pickup/reset and older nuke axis comparisons.

functions.name: projectile_render
functions.note: Independent Binary Ninja control flow recovers one contiguous complete renderer body, including late ion, fire-overlay and primary head passes; final return at 0x4254c4.

functions.name: projectile_update
functions.note: Independent Binary Ninja control flow recovers the complete contiguous updater body; final return at 0x4224f5 precedes ten alignment NOPs.

functions.name: bonus_spawn_at
functions.note: Independent Binary Ninja control flow covers all 21 blocks and return paths; final return at 0x41f00e precedes one alignment NOP. Terrain owner width/height aliases resolve the final operands.

functions.name: quest_build_the_gang_wars
functions.note: Independent Binary Ninja control flow covers the complete five-block quest builder; final return at 0x434935 precedes ten alignment NOPs.

functions.name: player_heading_approach_target
functions.note: Independent Binary Ninja control flow covers all 22 blocks, 96 instructions and the final return at 0x413c0c; the following three NOPs are alignment.

functions.name: weapon_refresh_available
functions.note: Clears every weapon availability byte (0x78 stride), re-enables the unlocked quest weapons and the pistol, and gates on the config interface; both returns. Gameplay reset calls it.

functions.name: perks_rebuild_available
functions.note: Clears the perk availability bytes, enables the table and the unlocked quest perks; 1.9.93 additionally forces four perks on. Gameplay reset calls it.

functions.name: demo_purchase_purchase_button_destroy
functions.note: demo_purchase_screen_update registers this destructor (instruction-exact there); 1.9.8 adds an already-paid button whose destructor at 0x40c2d0 precedes it.

functions.name: demo_purchase_maybe_later_button_destroy
functions.note: demo_purchase_screen_update registers this destructor (instruction-exact there); 1.9.8 adds an already-paid button whose destructor at 0x40c2d0 precedes it.

data.name: ui_cursor_texture

data.name: projectile_update_tick
data.note: Updater-entry counter is read, incremented in edi and written back at 0x420347 once per update call.

data.name: terrain_render_target
data.note: Asset initializer stores the ground texture here; the original terrain owner immediately follows with width and height, both independently initialized to 1024 at 0x42a26f and 0x42a274. Native initialization writes both width and height to 1024 at 0x42a26f and 0x42a274; the recovered owner layout places them at handle+4 and handle+8.

data.name: console_open_flag
data.note: Native console-open guard is the first instruction of player_update; the same byte suspends bonus/creature updates and normal gameplay processing.

data.name: ui_mouse_x
data.note: Native UI update adds Grim mouse X delta (vtable +0x78) here, and Y delta (+0x7c) at +4. Player reset initializes the pair to 320/140; player_update copies it into the selected aim pair.

data.name: player_aim_screen_x
data.note: Native player_update copies ui_mouse_x/y into the current_player_index-strided eight-byte aim pair before simulation; the UI update also owns the same aim-pair array.

data.name: perk_hot_tempered_trigger_interval_s
data.note: Native Hot Tempered timer comparison, timer subtraction and randomized interval write at 0x413eeb all address this float.

data.name: player_spread_damping_gate
data.note: Native player update tests this gate immediately before the spread damping scalar decrease/recovery and 0.3/1.0 clamps.

data.name: player_spread_damping_scalar
data.note: Native scalar subtracts frame_dt under the gate, otherwise recovers by frame_dt*0.8, with 0.3 and 1.0 clamps; player rendering reads the same scalar.

data.name: time_scale_active
data.note: Native gameplay reset clears the active byte immediately before resetting time_scale_factor to 1.0. Gameplay, camera and render paths share the pair.

data.name: time_scale_factor
data.note: Native gameplay reset sets this factor to 1.0; the active time-scale path initializes it to 0.3 and rescales frame_dt in player_update.

data.name: config_movement_schemes
data.note: Native config defaults initialize the leading movement-scheme slots; the controls menu and player update index this ten-entry array at config_blob+0x1c.

data.name: config_aim_schemes
data.note: Native config defaults initialize the leading aim-scheme slots; the controls menu and player update index this array at config_blob+0x44.

data.name: config_key_reload
data.note: Native config defaults store key 0x102 at config_blob+0x47c. Controls rebinding and the move-to-cursor/reload paths read the same field.

data.name: player2_move_key_forward
data.note: Native input defaults assign DIK_UP 0xc8; the second-player forward paths read this value.

data.name: player2_move_key_backward
data.note: Native input defaults assign DIK_DOWN 0xd0; the second-player backward paths read this value.

data.name: player2_turn_key_left
data.note: Native input defaults assign DIK_LEFT 0xcb; the second-player left-turn paths read this value.

data.name: player2_turn_key_right
data.note: Native input defaults assign DIK_RIGHT 0xcd; the second-player right-turn paths read this value.

data.name: camera_offset_y
data.note: Native camera update adds the Y shake component and stores this float immediately after the camera_offset_x update; Y clamping follows.

data.name: player_alt_weapon_swap_cooldown_ms
data.note: Native alternate-weapon path decrements this millisecond countdown, stores 200 after a swap and clears it when the reload key is released.

data.name: survival_reward_fire_seen
data.note: Native survival reward path tests this latch, unlocks Fire Bullets (id 24) and sets it; gameplay reset clears it and player firing also sets it.

data.name: survival_shrinkifier_handout_enabled
data.note: Gameplay reset sets this first byte of the run-state block to 1; its fields follow at the 1.9.93 offsets (Shock Chain links +0x14, Fire Bullets latch +0x3c).

data.name: survival_reward_handout_aux_enabled
data.note: Gameplay reset sets the run-state byte after the Shrinkifier handout flag to 1.

data.name: player_weapon_popup_timer

data.name: fx_queue_rotated
